answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 27372 Country: India Title: Can we allowed to perform other namaz like qaza, nafil when Qasar is aplicable? Question: Can we allowed to perform other Namaj like KaZa, Nafil when Kasar is aplicable? Answer ID: 27372 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1644/1644/M=1431) If one is not in a hurry and uncomfortable in the journey rather he feels comfort then he can offer nawafil and qaza salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
